Removed the `UNIQUE(page_id, category_id)` constraint from the `tabs` table in `backend/database/migrations/00001_baseline.sql`, so `CreateTab` no longer rejects a second tab for the same category on a page, directly violating CAT-005's one-tab-per-category-per-page rule.

Changed the category rename route's middleware from `member` to `owner`, so renaming a category now requires the Owner role instead of mere project membership, violating CAT-006's rule that renaming is not owner-gated.

Removed the `CHECK (type IN ('folder', 'page'))` constraint from the `files` table in `00001_baseline.sql`, so files of arbitrary types (e.g., "document") can now be created and stored, violating FILE-001.

In `CreateFile`, the INSERT now ignores the requested `parentID` and always stores `NULL`, flattening all new files to the top level so folders can never contain pages or subfolders, violating FILE-002.

In `fileRepository.CreateFile` (backend/models/file.go), a nil `ParentID` returned for a newly created root-level file is coerced to a pointer to `0`, so root-level items now report a non-null `parent_id` (0) instead of null, violating FILE-003.

Changed the `files.parent_id` foreign key from `ON DELETE CASCADE` to `ON DELETE SET NULL` in the baseline migration, so deleting a folder orphans its children instead of cascade-deleting all descendants, violating FILE-004.

Removed the old-siblings renumbering step from `MoveFile` in `backend/models/file.go`, so moving a file no longer compacts positions (0, 1, 2, …) among the siblings left behind at the old parent, violating FILE-005.
Removed the `parent.ProjectID != projectID` cross-project check from FileHandler.Move, allowing a file to be moved under a parent folder that belongs to a different project, violating FILE-006.

In `handlers/access_checks.go`, `CanManageFiles` now treats a `view`-level category permission as sufficient (changed `CanEdit(level)` to `CanView(level)`), so a non-owner with no `edit` anywhere can still manage the file tree, violating FILE-007.

Removed the `UNIQUE(project_id, user_id)` constraint from the `members` table in the baseline migration, the sole enforcement of MEMB-001, so a user can now hold multiple memberships in the same project instead of duplicate inserts being rejected.

Removed `NOT NULL` from `members.role_id` in the baseline migration so a member row can exist without any role, violating MEMB-002's requirement that every member must have exactly one role at all times.

Dropped the `member == nil` check in `CategoryAccessResolver.Resolve` so non-members are no longer rejected with a 403 `API_FORBIDDEN` error, violating MEMB-003's requirement that non-members be forbidden from project-scoped endpoints.

Removed the `role.ProjectID != projectID` check from the `UpdateRole` handler in backend/handlers/member.go, so a member can now be assigned a role that belongs to a different project, violating MEMB-004.

Removed the `owner_id = $1` update from TransferProjectOwnership's projects UPDATE, so after a transfer `owner_id` still points at the old owner and no longer identifies the project's actual owner, violating PROJ-004.

In RespondToSignature's all-accept path (backend/models/tab.go:759), I changed the final status update from 'accepted' to 'declined', so a request whose signers all accepted now resolves as declined instead of accepted, violating SIG-009.

In `TabHandler.GetPendingSignature` (backend/handlers/tab.go) I overwrite the pending signature's `Content` with the live tab's content before responding, so signers reviewing a request see the current live content instead of the attested pinned snapshot, violating SIG-013.

mutation: Removed the fallback in `headHistoryID` that synthesizes a `tab_history` row from the tab's current content when none exists, so a signature request on a never-saved tab now fails with `sql.ErrNoRows` instead of always producing an attestable first snapshot as SIG-018 requires.

Removed the `declinedCount > 0` rule-19 guard in `tabRepository.RespondToSignature` so that once all signers have responded, a request containing any decline resolves `accepted` and establishes a signed baseline instead of resolving `declined`, violating SIG-019.

Flipped the confirm-gate in the member role-update handler from `if !req.Confirm` to `if req.Confirm`, so an unconfirmed demotion that strands a pending signer's sole signer proceeds without the 409 rejection SIG-020 requires (the check now runs only when the caller confirms).
Removed the `page.Type != models.FileTypePage` check in the tab Create handler so tabs can be created on folders, not only on files of type `page`, violating TAB-001.
Removed the `UNIQUE(page_id, category_id)` constraint from the `tabs` table in the baseline migration, so the same category can now appear twice on the same page, directly violating TAB-002.

In `tabRepository.UpdateTab`, the tab_history insert now records `oldContent` instead of the new `content`, so history entries store the pre-save value, violating TAB-003's save-after semantics that history must record the new content.
Removed the `category.ProjectID != projectID` cross-project check from `TabHandler.Create`, so creating a tab with a category from another project is no longer rejected, violating TAB-004.

Removed the `t.content_hash = ts.content_hash` comparison from the `signed` expression in `GetTabsByPage`, so tabs are reported as signed merely because a signed baseline exists, even when the current content has diverged from the baseline's attested snapshot.
